question: As of 31st July 2025, who is the current Chief Justice of the Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Arun Palli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice Arun Palli** is the current Chief Justice of the **Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court** as of **31st July 2025**.
 
• He was appointed to this position after serving as a judge in the **Punjab and Haryana High Court**.
 
• Justice Arun Palli has a distinguished legal career, known for his expertise in constitutional and civil law.
 
• The Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court is a common High Court for both Union Territories, established after the bifurcation of the erstwhile state of Jammu and Kashmir under the **Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019**.
 
• As Chief Justice, his role includes overseeing judicial administration and ensuring the timely delivery of justice in the Union Territories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jammu & Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019:**

 
 
• This act was passed by the Indian Parliament to bifurcate the state of Jammu and Kashmir into two Union Territories – **Jammu & Kashmir** (with a legislature) and **Ladakh** (without a legislature).
 
• The High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh serves both Union Territories, ensuring judicial independence and access to justice.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Chief Justice:**
 
 
• The Chief Justice is the head of the High Court and is responsible for judicial and administrative functions.
 
• They ensure the smooth functioning of the court and oversee the allocation of cases among judges.
 
• The Chief Justice plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity and efficiency of the judiciary in the region.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Judges:**
 
 
• **Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai:** Currently a judge in the **Supreme Court of India**, he has delivered several landmark judgments but is not associated with the Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court.
 
• **Justice Dinesh Maheshwari:** Also a judge in the Supreme Court of India, he specializes in administrative and constitutional law.
 
• **Judge Kaveri Baweja:** She is not currently serving in the Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court or as Chief Justice.
 
 
 
• **Judiciary in Union Territories:**
 
 
• The judiciary in Union Territories functions under the supervision of the respective High Courts.
 
• The Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court plays a pivotal role in addressing legal issues unique to the region.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Judicial Appointments:**

 
 
• The Chief Justice of a High Court is appointed by the **President of India** in consultation with the **Chief Justice of India** and the Governor of the respective state/Union Territory.
 
• This process ensures transparency and meritocracy in the judiciary.
 
 
 
• **Judicial Reforms:**
 
 
• The Government of India has introduced several reforms to streamline judicial processes and reduce pendency in courts.
 
• Digitization of court records and e-court initiatives have been implemented to improve efficiency.
 
 
 
• **History of the Jammu & Kashmir High Court:**
 
 
• The High Court of Jammu & Kashmir was established in **1928** during the reign of Maharaja Hari Singh.
 
• Post reorganization in 2019, it became the High Court for both Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.
